recipes.name: Szechuan Sauce Revisited (From Real Sample!)
instructions: Combine water, vinegar, sesame seed oil, garlic powder, onion powder, garlic powder, ground ginger, marmite, corn syrup ground pepper, white sugar, soy sauce and apple cider vinegar in a medium sized bowl and transfer to a medium sauce pan. - ½ cup water - ½ cup white vinegar - ½ tsp sesame seed oil - ¼ tsp garlic powder - ¼ tsp onion powder - ¼ tsp ground ginger - ¼ yeast extract (marmite) - ¼ dextrose (corn syrup) - Ground black pepper to taste - ½ cup white sugar - ½ cup soy sauce - 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar

Remove 1/4 cup of sauce and add cornstarch. Remove another 1/4 cup and add the xanthan gum. Add both back into the mixture, straining the xanthan gum mixture for lumps and whisk over medium heat until it forms a sauce like goo. Strain, cover and let it cool down. - 2 tbsp cornstarch - 1 tsp xanthan gum
Put two chicken breast skins in the freezer to firm for thirty minutes. Process in a food processor while still cold until they become a fine paste. - 2 chicken breast skins

Place paste in bowl and add the pound of ground chicken, garlic powder, onion powder, white pepper, kosher salt and white sugar. Beat together well until they turn into a smooth paste. - ½ tsp garlic powder - ½ tsp onion powder - ½ tsp white pepper - 2 tbsp kosher salt - 2 tbsp white sugar

Pour onto parchment-lined baking sheet and smooth out until it’s a quarter inch thick. To make sure it's uniform, spray a parchment-lined cutting board with cooking spray and press down on the meat to form a flat chicken patty. Place in the freezer to firm up.
Use nugget cutouts to form nuggets, place on an oiled sheet of parchment paper and put them in the freezer to firm until ready to fry.
Combine vegetable oil, canola oil and beef fat tallow in frying pan and heat to 350°F. - Canola oil - Vegetable oil - Beef fat tallow

Combine white flour, cornstarch, corn flour and black pepper in medium bowl. Add water, vodka and the egg and stir until smooth - 1 cup white flour - ½ cup cornstarch - ½ cup corn flour - Black pepper to taste - 1 cup water - 1 cup vodka - 1 egg
Coat nuggets in batter and fry for 5-7 minutes or until golden brown and sprinkle with salt as soon as they come out of the fryer.
For the Chicken Nugget Cookie Cutters
Cut four, 3-inch wide, 12-inch long strips out of the baking sheet.
Fold in half, in the long direction, leaving a little lip that can be folded over so that there are no razor sharp edges exposed.
Form strips into the four Chicken McNugget shapes: The bell, the ball, the bone, and the boot.
